def: An MLCommons metadata vocabulary for machine-learning datasets, built on schema.org, that describes a dataset’s files, structure and semantics in machine-readable form.
practice: Hugging Face, Kaggle and OpenML serve Croissant files, NeurIPS’s Datasets and Benchmarks track asks for one, and version 1.1 (February 2026) adds provenance (as of November 2026).
